name: visual_assembly
description: Build or modify a scene-graph Document using ops. Pick a preset and let the engine replicate + bind, or layer ops on top.

preset.description: Named preset published for this tenant. See <tenant_design_context> for the full list. Pair with `ops` to apply overrides on top — ops can target preset slot ids (card-meta, card-brand, card-actions, etc.).

ops.description: Operations on the Document tree. Use without `preset` for freestyle ops; use with `preset` for overrides on top of a published template.

target.description: Node id (from tree_map) for update/delete/move. Component-internal ids inside resolved instances are shared across clones — go through the ref slot id.

ref.description: Local binding name — subsequent ops can reference via $ref.

props.description: Properties to set on the node. Merged in update ops.

ref.description: For type=ref: id of the component definition to point at.

fieldBinding.description: Catalog field key (see <fields>). Engine fills value from data.

content.description: Literal value for leaf nodes that don't read from data.

fills.description: For image nodes: array of fill specs. {type:'image', url:'...', mode:'fill'|'fit'|'stretch'}.

slot.description: Semantic role of this node within its preset (hero, title, price, badge, ...). Frontend renderer uses it for default styling.

replicate.description: Number of clones to fan out from the preset's replicate-marked subtree. Engine stamps fresh ids on each clone and sets dataIndex:i for binding. 0 or omitted = no replication (single instance).
